name: Hoi An resort living
summary: Cua Dai beach resorts when you want the old town at night and a quiet sand morning.
body: Cua Dai is the sand east of the old town. An Bang is closer and busier. Sleep here when the morning is the beach and the evening is still the timber streets.

properties.name: Palm Garden Beach Resort & Spa
properties.summary: Cua Dai beach resort on Lac Long Quan, with the garden between the lobby and the sand.

properties.name: Victoria Hoi An Beach Resort & Spa
properties.summary: Cua Dai beach fishing-village style between the De Vong River and the sea.
